title: Boy Drowns in River Lea Near Hackney Marshes
summary: A 12-year-old boy has drowned in the River Lea near Hackney Marshes. The incident occurred in London. The exact circumstances surrounding the drowning are not detailed in the provided coverage.
summary_points: A 12-year-old boy drowned in the River Lea.
The incident took place near Hackney Marshes in London.
No further details on the circumstances were provided in the coverage.

summary_points_hi: 12 वर्षीय लड़के की ली नदी में डूबने से मौत हो गई।

कवरेज में घटना की परिस्थितियों के बारे में कोई अतिरिक्त विवरण नहीं दिया गया था।
